A, the opposite leg from the SCREEN-LEFT NEAR HIP under the turquoise beads/blue tassel, must swing FORWARD to the LARGE AIRBORNE FOOT on screen-right. 2. FAR support thigh B starts at the screen-right hip under the right gold-edged coat flap. Phase16: last toe-contact: ankle extended most, heel highest, final toe pad still pressing before support changes in next frame. B rear boot is heel-up/toe-down on the implied ground. A front boot has its toe raised with underside visible, unmistakably AIRBORNE. Both shoes horizontal heading SE diagonal screen-down-right, no external splay. Preserve image1 exact upper body, face/head size, hair, scarf, shoulders, elbows, BOTH hands and BOTH crescent daggers with original orientation and phase. Do not move/scale/rotate whole character. Preserve wholecanvas framing and complete extremities. Image3 bamboo is ONLY heading/perspective, never copy her pose or leg assignment; image4 painted-art style only.
